parameters.command:
=# 1. Ensure session exists
tmux has-session -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }} 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}

# 2. Generate unique start and end markers
START_MARKER="CMD_START_$$_$(date +%s)"
END_MARKER="CMD_END_$$_$(date +%s)"

# 3. Send the command wrapped with markers
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}:0 "echo $START_MARKER; tree {{ $json.directory }} --filelimit 20; echo $END_MARKER" C-m

# 4. Wait for the end marker to appear
while true; do
    sleep 0.5
    tmux capture-pane -pt n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}:0 > /tmp/tmux_output_$$
    if grep -q "$END_MARKER" /tmp/tmux_output_$$; then
        break
    fi
done

# 5. Extract only the output between the markers
sed -n "/$START_MARKER/,/$END_MARKER/{
    /$START_MARKER/d
    /$END_MARKER/d
    p
}" /tmp/tmux_output_$$

# 6. Clean up
rm /tmp/tmux_output_$$
